situation.zh-TW: 取車櫃台正在核對駕照、譯本、護照與租車資料。
situation.en: At the rental counter, staff check your licence, translation, passport, and booking.

watch.zh-TW: 證件缺一項，可能當場無法取車。
watch.en: A missing document can stop the rental handover.

action.zh-TW: 出發前逐項放進同一個文件袋，取車時照清單核對。
action.en: Keep every document together and check them against one list before pickup.

situation.zh-TW: 從停車場駛上雙向道路，準備左轉。
situation.en: You are leaving a car park and turning left onto a two-way road.

watch.zh-TW: 最容易順著台灣習慣切進右側逆向車道。
watch.en: Right-driving muscle memory can pull you into oncoming traffic.

action.zh-TW: 轉完後確認車身在左側車道，方向盤與駕駛座靠道路中央。
action.en: Finish in the left lane, with the driver side toward the road centre.

situation.zh-TW: 你停在紅燈前，左轉方向完全沒有車或行人。
situation.en: You are stopped at a red light and the left turn looks completely clear.

watch.zh-TW: 日本不是看到路口沒車就能紅燈左轉。
watch.en: An empty junction does not make a red-light turn legal.

action.zh-TW: 停在停止線前；等綠燈或適用方向的綠色箭頭再走。
action.en: Stop before the line and wait for green or an applicable green arrow.

situation.zh-TW: 主燈是紅燈，但右轉綠色箭頭亮起。
situation.en: The main light is red while a green right arrow is illuminated.

watch.zh-TW: 箭頭只開放它指示的方向，不代表其他方向也能走。
watch.en: The arrow releases only its indicated direction.

action.zh-TW: 確認行人與路口安全後，只依亮起箭頭的方向通行。
action.en: Check the crossing, then proceed only in the arrow's direction.

situation.zh-TW: 前方號誌不是恆亮，而是閃紅或閃黃。
situation.en: The signal ahead is flashing red or flashing yellow.

watch.zh-TW: 兩種閃燈的動作不同，不能都當成慢慢通過。
watch.en: The required action differs; both are not simply slow-and-go.

action.zh-TW: 閃紅先完全停車再確認；閃黃減速並注意安全通過。
action.en: Stop fully at flashing red; slow and proceed carefully at flashing yellow.

situation.zh-TW: 抵達止まれ與停止線，路口看起來沒有來車。
situation.en: You reach a 止まれ sign and stop line with no obvious traffic.

watch.zh-TW: 滑行到極慢不算停車，輪胎必須完全停止。
watch.en: A rolling stop is still not a stop.

action.zh-TW: 在線前停死，再左右確認；視線受阻時再慢慢探頭。
action.en: Stop fully before the line, check both ways, then edge forward only if needed.

situation.zh-TW: 綠燈右轉時，對向車正要直行通過。
situation.en: You are turning right on green while an oncoming car continues straight.

watch.zh-TW: 右轉車會穿越對向直行路徑，搶先轉最危險。
watch.en: Your turn crosses the oncoming vehicle's path.

action.zh-TW: 先讓對向直行車通過，再轉入東向左側車道。
action.en: Yield to the oncoming car, then enter the left side of the eastbound road.

situation.zh-TW: 準備左轉，左側空隙可能讓自行車或機車鑽入。
situation.en: You are preparing to turn left and a cyclist or motorcycle could enter the gap on your left.

watch.zh-TW: 車身離路邊太遠會留下危險空隙；靠左也不能取代後視鏡、肩後與斑馬線確認。
watch.en: Positioning too far from the edge leaves a dangerous gap; moving left never replaces mirror, shoulder, and crossing checks.

action.zh-TW: 提早打燈，確認左側安全後靠近道路左端慢行；若左側已有人車就先讓。
action.en: Signal early, check the left side, approach close to the edge and turn slowly; yield if someone is already beside you.

situation.zh-TW: 住宅區窄路口被建物與圍牆遮住視線。
situation.en: Buildings and walls hide traffic at a narrow residential junction.

watch.zh-TW: 沒看到車不代表沒有車，直接切入會來不及反應。
watch.en: Not seeing traffic is not proof that the junction is clear.

action.zh-TW: 進路口前先降到能立即停住的速度，再分段確認。
action.en: Slow enough to stop immediately and check the junction in stages.

situation.zh-TW: 接近斑馬線，旁邊有人面向道路等候。
situation.en: You approach a crossing where someone is waiting at the roadside.

watch.zh-TW: 不要猜他會不會走，也不要逼行人讓車。
watch.en: Do not guess whether the person will cross or pressure them to wait.

action.zh-TW: 提早減速並準備在線前停車，讓行人先過。
action.en: Slow early, be ready to stop before the line, and let the pedestrian cross.

situation.zh-TW: 窄路上要超越前方自行車，但側向空間不足。
situation.en: You want to pass a cyclist on a narrow road with limited clearance.

watch.zh-TW: 貼車超越時，自行車一個晃動就可能碰撞。
watch.en: A small cyclist wobble can cause a collision during a close pass.

action.zh-TW: 先減速跟車；確認對向安全且能留足空間再超越。
action.en: Slow and wait; pass only when oncoming traffic and clearance are safe.

situation.zh-TW: 左邊是無中央線生活道路；右邊有中央線。
situation.en: The left road has no centre line; the right road does.

watch.zh-TW: 2026 新制有日期與適用範圍；看不到相機也不是超速理由。
watch.en: The 2026 change has a date and defined scope; not seeing a camera is no reason to speed.

action.zh-TW: 先讀現場速限。沒有指定時，再依道路類型與當期規則判斷；不要跟著前車超速。
action.en: Read the posted limit first. If none is posted, apply the current rule for that road type and do not copy a speeding lead vehicle.

situation.zh-TW: 平交道柵欄開著，但軌道另一側正在塞車。
situation.en: The railway gate is open, but traffic blocks the space beyond the tracks.

watch.zh-TW: 只看柵欄就進去，可能被卡在軌道上。
watch.en: Entering on the gate alone can leave you trapped on the tracks.

action.zh-TW: 先停車確認；出口沒有完整車身空間就不要進入。
action.en: Stop and check; enter only when your entire vehicle can clear the tracks.

situation.zh-TW: 前方出現倒三角形的「止まれ／STOP」。
situation.en: A red inverted-triangle 止まれ / STOP sign appears ahead.

watch.zh-TW: 外型和台灣常見八角形不同，容易反應慢半拍。
watch.en: Its shape differs from the octagonal stop sign used in many places.

action.zh-TW: 看到就找停止線，在線前完全停車再確認。
action.en: Find the stop line, stop fully before it, then check the junction.

situation.zh-TW: 導航路線前方同時可能出現禁止進入或單行道指示。
situation.en: Your route may meet a no-entry or one-way sign.

watch.zh-TW: 導航不是現場交通指示，不能蓋過路標。
watch.en: Navigation cannot override the sign in front of you.

action.zh-TW: 以現場標誌為準；不能進就安全改道，不要硬轉。
action.en: Follow the sign and reroute safely instead of forcing the turn.

situation.zh-TW: 路邊看到紅色叉號或單斜線的藍底圓形標誌。
situation.en: You see either a red X or a single red slash on a blue circular sign.

watch.zh-TW: 叉號連臨時停車都禁止；單斜線主要禁止停車，兩者不同。
watch.en: The X prohibits stopping and parking; the slash prohibits parking.

action.zh-TW: 先辨認符號，再看附加時段與箭頭；不確定就找停車場。
action.en: Read the symbol, time panel, and arrows; use a car park if unsure.

situation.zh-TW: 速限標誌顯示 50。
situation.en: A speed-limit sign displays 50.

watch.zh-TW: 50 是這張圖的現場數字，不是日本所有道路的固定速限。
watch.en: The displayed 50 is not a universal limit for every road.

action.zh-TW: 每段路重新看現場數字，並依天候與視線再降低速度。
action.en: Read the posted number on each road and slow further for conditions.

situation.zh-TW: 前方可能有斑馬線或平交道。
situation.en: A pedestrian crossing or railway crossing may be ahead.

watch.zh-TW: 警告標誌是在提醒你提早準備，不是到設施前才急煞。
watch.en: The warning is a cue to prepare early, not brake at the last moment.

action.zh-TW: 先收油、掃描路側與前方，預留能平順停車的距離。
action.en: Ease off, scan both sides and ahead, and preserve a smooth stopping distance.

situation.zh-TW: 接近收費站，需要在 ETC 與一般車道間選擇。
situation.en: You approach a toll gate and must choose between ETC and general lanes.

watch.zh-TW: 到閘口才發現車道不對，急切車比走錯更危險。
watch.en: A last-second lane change is more dangerous than choosing early.

action.zh-TW: 提早確認租車 ETC 狀態；沒有可用 ETC 就走一般車道。
action.en: Confirm the rental's ETC status early; otherwise choose a general lane.

situation.zh-TW: 路邊出現黃色實線或黃色破線。
situation.en: A solid or broken yellow line runs along the roadside.

watch.zh-TW: 實線禁止駐車與臨時停車；破線禁止駐車，兩者不能混為一談。
watch.en: A solid line prohibits stopping and parking; a broken line prohibits parking.

action.zh-TW: 先辨認線型，再讀標誌、附牌與管制範圍；不確定就進停車場。
action.en: Identify the line, then read signs, plates, and the controlled length; use a car park if uncertain.

situation.zh-TW: 從加速車道準備匯入高速公路主線。
situation.en: You are entering the expressway from an acceleration lane.

watch.zh-TW: 速度差太大或太早切入，主線車輛很難配合。
watch.en: A large speed difference or early merge leaves little room for others.

action.zh-TW: 在加速車道建立接近主線的速度，找安全空檔平順匯入。
action.en: Match mainline speed in the acceleration lane and merge into a safe gap.

situation.zh-TW: 高速公路右側超車道目前很空。
situation.en: The right-hand passing lane is currently clear.

watch.zh-TW: 右側是超車用，不是一路巡航的固定車道。
watch.en: The right lane is for passing, not continuous cruising.

action.zh-TW: 完成超車並保持安全距離後，回到左側主要行車道。
action.en: After passing with safe clearance, return to the left driving lane.

situation.zh-TW: 收費站同時有一般、ETC／一般與 ETC 專用車道。
situation.en: The toll gate has general, mixed ETC/general, and ETC-only lanes.

watch.zh-TW: 租車有設備不代表卡片一定插好或可用。
watch.en: An ETC unit in the car does not guarantee a working card.

action.zh-TW: 取車時實際確認設備與卡片；不確定就選一般車道。
action.en: Confirm the unit and card at pickup; choose general if uncertain.

situation.zh-TW: 自助加油機出現レギュラー、ハイオク與軽油。
situation.en: The pump offers regular, high-octane, and 軽油 diesel.

watch.zh-TW: 「軽油」不是輕型車用油，加錯油可能造成嚴重損壞。
watch.en: 軽油 means diesel, not fuel for light vehicles.

action.zh-TW: 看油箱蓋、租車文件或直接問店員，不要只靠油槍顏色猜。
action.en: Check the fuel door and rental documents or ask staff; never guess by colour alone.

situation.zh-TW: 車輛在高速公路故障，已停到安全處並完成警示。
situation.en: Your vehicle has broken down on an expressway and warning measures are set.

watch.zh-TW: 留在車內可能被後方車輛追撞。
watch.en: Remaining in the vehicle leaves occupants exposed to a rear impact.

action.zh-TW: 全員離車到護欄外安全處，再聯絡道路救援與警方。
action.en: Move everyone behind the guardrail, then contact road assistance and police.

situation.zh-TW: 前方白色斜線導流帶把車流分向不同車道。
situation.en: White hatched guide strips channel traffic into different lanes.

watch.zh-TW: 斜線區不是多一條車道，也不是插隊或臨停空間。
watch.en: The hatched area is not another lane, a shortcut, or a stopping bay.

action.zh-TW: 提早選路，沿導流帶外側與車道箭頭行駛；錯過就往前改道。
action.en: Choose early and follow the lane around the strip; continue and reroute if you miss it.

situation.zh-TW: 低車流支道路口紅燈很久，前方是感應號誌。
situation.en: A low-volume side road remains red at an actuated signal.

watch.zh-TW: 停太後面或越過停止線，車輛可能不在感應範圍。
watch.en: Stopping too far back or beyond the line may leave the vehicle outside the detection area.

action.zh-TW: 停在停止線前的偵測位置，保持不動並等待；有按鈕或告示就照現場操作。
action.en: Stop in the detection position before the line and wait; follow any local button or instruction.

situation.zh-TW: 有路面電車的路口亮起黃色箭頭。
situation.en: A yellow arrow illuminates at a junction with streetcars.

watch.zh-TW: 黃色箭頭只供路面電車，汽車不能跟著箭頭走。
watch.en: The yellow arrow is for streetcars only; cars must not follow it.

action.zh-TW: 汽車看自己車道的圓形燈或綠色箭頭；沒有許可信號就停。
action.en: Cars obey their own circular light or green arrow and remain stopped without a permissive signal.

situation.zh-TW: 要轉進路邊停車場、加油站或商店，入口前有人行道。
situation.en: You are entering a roadside car park, fuel station, or shop across a sidewalk.

watch.zh-TW: 直接斜切可能擋住對向車流，也可能漏看人行道上的行人與自行車。
watch.en: A diagonal cut can block opposing traffic and hide pedestrians or cyclists on the sidewalk.

action.zh-TW: 在人行道前停車讓行；看不清或會橫擋車流時，到合法安全處改成同向接近。
action.en: Stop and yield before the sidewalk; if visibility is poor or traffic would be blocked, re-approach from the same direction after a lawful safe reorientation.

situation.zh-TW: 山路遇到雨雪、霧與低能見度。
situation.en: Rain, light snow, and fog reduce visibility on a mountain road.

watch.zh-TW: 導航預估時間沒有把抓地力與看不見的彎道算進去。
watch.en: Navigation time estimates do not account for grip and hidden bends.

action.zh-TW: 降速、拉長車距；沒有合適輪胎或信心就改搭其他交通。
action.en: Slow down, increase distance, and change transport if tyres or confidence are inadequate.

situation.zh-TW: 喝酒、服藥、疲勞或身體不適後，正在決定要不要開車。
situation.en: You are deciding whether to drive after alcohol, medicine, fatigue, or illness.

watch.zh-TW: 覺得『應該還好』不是安全判斷，宿醉也可能影響駕駛。
watch.en: Feeling 'probably fine' is not a reliable safety test; hangovers can still impair driving.

action.zh-TW: 把鑰匙放下，改搭電車、計程車或請清醒的人駕駛。
action.en: Set the keys aside and use transit, a taxi, or a fit designated driver.
